shortDescription: Create, update or destroy an aaa group object in Sophos UTM

options.name: adirectory_groups
options.description: List of adirectory group strings.

options.name: adirectory_groups_sids
options.description: Dictionary of group sids.

options.name: backend_match
options.description: The backend for the group.

options.name: comment
options.description: Comment that describes the AAA group.

options.name: dynamic
options.description: Group type. Is static if none is selected.

options.name: edirectory_groups
options.description: List of edirectory group strings.

options.name: headers
options.description: A dictionary of additional headers to be sent to POST and PUT requests. Is needed for some modules.

options.name: ipsec_dn
options.description: The ipsec dn string.

options.name: ldap_attribute
options.description: The ldap attribute to check against.

options.name: ldap_attribute_value
options.description: The ldap attribute value to check against.

options.name: members
options.description: A list of user ref names (aaa/user).

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the object that identifies the entry.

options.name: network
options.description: The network reference name. The objects contains the known IP addresses for the authentication object (network/aaa).

options.name: radius_groups
options.description: A list of radius group strings.

options.name: state
options.description: The desired state of the object. V(present) creates or updates an object. V(absent) deletes an object if present.

options.name: tacacs_groups
options.description: A list of tacacs group strings.

options.name: utm_host
options.description: The REST Endpoint of the Sophos UTM.

options.name: utm_port
options.description: The port of the REST interface.

options.name: utm_protocol
options.description: The protocol of the REST Endpoint.

options.name: utm_token
options.description: The token used to identify at the REST-API. See U(https://www.sophos.com/en-us/medialibrary/PDFs/documentation/UTMonAWS/Sophos-UTM-RESTful-API.pdf?la=en), Chapter 2.4.2.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether the REST interface's SSL certificate should be verified or not.
